tonight.headline: A coin flip now — Footballers set their lineup
body: Bad news first: Tuten's ankle is not settled. Coen said Monday he 'probably won't be able to do a ton' in practice this week, as for the last few weeks, and the team will 'see where we're at towards the end of the week' (Yahoo, 24 Nov). You are 4-7 after losing 71.16 to 137.5.

This morning ESPN had you 64%. At 15:11 UTC Footballers started Smith-Njigba, Judkins and Watson; it is now 128.6 to 128.6, 50%. Your lineup is already the projection lineup and no claim tonight improves it. The one decision left is Tuten at 10:30 Sunday.

case.label: The script that beats you
case.body: Bowers plays for them (Kubiak 'optimistic', NBC 22 Nov), Tuten sits and the fallback is not made by 10:30 Sunday, and Wilson stalls against Miami (4th-fewest WR points allowed).

case.label: What would change it
case.body: Omar Cooper Jr. ruled out for the Jets (his Week 12 availability is 'in doubt', NBC 24 Nov) — more of New York's targets for Wilson. Or Tuten practising fully by Friday.

doFirst.title: If Tuten is inactive: Gordon to RB, Diggs to FLEX
doFirst.subtitle: Tuten starts if active. Fallback decided now; Diggs over Etienne is a coin flip, so it goes to the projection.

case.label: The player
case.body: Tuten re-aggravated his ankle when he was stepped on twice on one play in Week 11. Coen: 'The recheck today wasn't too bad', but he 'probably won't be able to do a ton' in practice (Yahoo, 24 Nov 03:01Z). NBC's Week 12 report (24 Nov) expects him to play through it. Jacksonville are 14.5-point favourites over Tennessee (ESPN).

case.label: The fallback
case.body: If he sits, move Gordon to RB and start Diggs (12.7, plays 15:25) in FLEX. Etienne (12.0) straight into the RB slot is within 0.7. That is a coin flip, so it goes to the projection and gets no thesis. This morning's 2.1-point gap was computed on 07:00 projections and no longer holds.

case.label: The clock
case.body: Inactives at 10:30 CDMX Sunday, 90 minutes before JAX-TEN. Jacksonville's Wednesday and Thursday practices are the evidence Coen said he would use.

case.label: Falsified if
case.body: Tuten is active and Diggs outscores him (archive), or Tuten is inactive and the slot scores zero.

action.label: If inactive: start Diggs · bench Tuten

whatWentWrong.title: Tuten played hurt and lost his slot to Diggs by 0.2
whatWentWrong.lead: 8.3 on a bad ankle against Diggs' 8.5 on the bench. The Week 11 thesis closes WRONG.

case.label: What happened
case.body: Tuten was active, aggravated the ankle and limped off; he finished 8.3 to Diggs' 8.5 (archive, both final). The written falsifier fired by 0.2.

case.label: What changes
case.body: This week the fallback is named in advance: if Tuten is inactive at 10:30 Sunday, Gordon moves to RB and Diggs starts in FLEX.

case.label: Falsified if
case.body: The contingency is needed and not made — then the process, not the injury, cost the slot.

worthALook.name: Antonio Williams
worthALook.lead: Washington's No. 2 receiver now — but you have no seat for him.

case.label: The player
case.body: 9 catches for 122 in Week 11, a career high; McLaurin's season-ending patellar rupture made him Washington's No. 2 (NBC 24 Nov). Yahoo (24 Nov): 'should be owned in all leagues', favourable schedule ahead.

case.label: Why not now
case.body: He would not start over Jefferson, Wilson or Diggs, and the waiver tool's weakest movable receiver, Ayomanor, is on the screen's exposure list. Metcalf is 88% owned.

case.label: What would change it
case.body: A Jefferson, Wilson or Diggs injury before Sunday. Claims are free in Chem and clear at 02:00 tonight, but he would sit on your bench behind three receivers.
